topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: When I saw the name on the school's roster, it felt like a whisper from a distant past, a past I thought was respectfully buried. Mrs. Hilton, my own classroom guide from years gone, now teaching my child. The room seemed to close in, the walls breathless with secrets. I watch my child, eager and unknowing, ready to embrace the lessons that once shaped me, the corridors of my childhood echoing softly in their steps. I find myself lingering at the school gates longer than necessary, eyes tracing the path they take towards the building, each brick a silent sentinel of days long past.
